name: dmsone-flex-mcp-server
description: Local MCP server for the DMS One Flex API (Claude Desktop / any MCP client). Wraps the same REST API as n8n-nodes-dmsone-flex.

scripts.bundle: npm run build && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build/pkg && cp -R dist manifest.json icon.png package.json README.md INSTALL-WINDOWS.md INSTALL-MACOS.md .env.example build/pkg/ && (cd build/pkg && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund) && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack build/pkg "dmsone-flex-$npm_package_version.mcpb"

author: DMS One
